title: The Creator
summary: Reveal the Creator through the sentries and an Identify interaction with the quest crystal.
overview: This guide covers the level 68+ mission configuration.
Reveal the Creator through the sentries and an Identify interaction with the quest crystal.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prepare the group before the Identify cast and hold the crystal on the target player's cursor.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The third actual defunct-sentry kill summons a Furious Sentry in one of two rooms.
Cast Identify on a player holding the required energy crystal on their cursor.
That interaction summons Creator Kro`val with one crag sentinel and three stone sentinels, and advances the Identify objective.
The Creator reveal occurs once per controller load.

notes: Approval R021. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
This guide is limited to the level 68+ mission configuration. The source hardcodes those NPC templates; lower-difficulty mappings remain unfinished.
